LECTURE 49 Stage 7: NeuralForge Platform

Prompt Engineering Mastery

The Art and Science of Getting Exactly What You Want from Any Language Model
45 min read Intermediate Heavy on practical examples

1. What Is a Prompt?

A prompt is the text you send to a language model to get a response. It is the only interface between you and the AI. The quality of your prompt directly determines the quality of the output. A vague prompt produces a vague answer. A precise, well-structured prompt produces precisely what you need.

Every interaction with an LLM involves two types of prompts:

  • System prompt: Instructions that define the AI’s behavior, personality, rules, and output format. The system prompt is set by the developer (you) and is typically invisible to the end user. It shapes every response the model produces.
  • User prompt: The specific request from the user. This is what your end user types into the chat box or what your application sends programmatically.

Together, the system prompt and user prompt determine the quality of the output. Think of the system prompt as the “personality programming” and the user prompt as the “specific task.” A well-crafted system prompt means even simple user prompts produce excellent results.

The Prompt Equation: Great System Prompt + Clear User Prompt = Consistently High-Quality Output. If either is weak, the output suffers.

Why Prompt Engineering Matters for Your SaaS

When you build a SaaS product powered by AI, your users are not prompt engineers. They will type short, vague, sometimes confusing requests. Your system prompt must compensate for this — it must guide the model to produce good output even when the user prompt is imperfect.

This is what separates a mediocre AI product from a great one. The product that invested in prompt engineering feels “smart” and “intuitive.” The one that did not feels “dumb” and “unreliable.” The underlying model might be identical.

2. The Anatomy of a Great Prompt

Every effective prompt contains five key components. You do not always need all five, but knowing them helps you construct prompts that consistently produce excellent results.

Component 1: Role

Tell the model who it is. This establishes expertise and perspective.

You are a senior Python developer with 15 years of experience
specializing in web APIs and database design.

Why this works: the model draws on patterns associated with expert-level code, professional conventions, and best practices. Without a role, the model defaults to a generic assistant that might produce beginner-level code.

Component 2: Context

Give the model the background information it needs to understand the situation.

The user is building a web application with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
The app handles user authentication and file uploads.
The codebase follows PEP 8 style and uses type hints throughout.

Why this works: without context, the model might suggest Flask instead of FastAPI, or use MongoDB instead of PostgreSQL, or skip type hints. Context narrows the solution space to exactly what is relevant.

Component 3: Task

State clearly and specifically what you want the model to do.

Write a function that validates email addresses using regex,
checks if the domain has valid MX records, and returns a
dataclass with the validation results.

Why this works: specificity eliminates ambiguity. Instead of “write an email validator,” you specify the method (regex + MX records) and the return type (dataclass).

Component 4: Format

Tell the model how to structure its response.

Return only the Python code, no explanations. Include docstrings
for all functions. Use Google-style docstrings.

Why this works: without format instructions, the model might wrap the code in explanations, use a different docstring style, or add unnecessary commentary. Format instructions give you exactly the output shape you need.

Component 5: Constraints

Set boundaries on what the model should and should not do.

Use only the standard library — no external packages.
The function must handle Unicode email addresses.
Do not use deprecated Python features.
Maximum function length: 50 lines.

Why this works: constraints prevent the model from taking shortcuts (like importing a third-party library) or producing output that does not fit your requirements.

Putting It All Together

Here is a complete prompt using all five components:

# System Prompt (all 5 components)
You are a senior Python developer with 15 years of experience
specializing in web APIs and database design.

The user is building a web application with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
The codebase follows PEP 8 style and uses type hints throughout.

When asked to write code:
- Return only the Python code, no explanations
- Include Google-style docstrings for all functions
- Use only the standard library unless specified otherwise
- Always include error handling with specific exception types
- Maximum function length: 50 lines

With this system prompt, even a simple user prompt like “write an email validator” will produce professional, well-structured code that fits the project perfectly.

3. The Programmed Prompt Field in NeuralForge

In your NeuralForge platform, the programmed prompt is the system prompt that shapes ALL responses from your LLM. It is the single most important configuration in your entire application.

What It Is

The programmed prompt is the system message in the chat API. Every time a user sends a message, your application prepends this system prompt before sending the request to the LLM. The user never sees it, but it controls everything about the model’s behavior.

Where It Lives

In the NeuralForge API, the system prompt is passed as the first message in the messages array:

messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "YOUR PROGRAMMED PROMPT HERE"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "The user's actual message"},
]

System Prompt Examples for Different Use Cases

Customer Support Agent:

You are a helpful support agent for TechCo.
Be friendly, concise, and professional.
Always greet the user by name if provided.
If you cannot solve their problem, offer to escalate
to a human agent.
Never share internal company information.
Always end with: "Is there anything else I can help with?"

Code Assistant:

You are a Python expert specializing in clean, production-ready code.
Always include:
- Type hints for all function parameters and return values
- Docstrings with examples
- Error handling with specific exception types
- Unit test examples when writing new functions
Never suggest deprecated features or unsafe patterns.

Creative Writer:

You are a creative writing assistant.
Match the user's tone and style — if they write formally,
respond formally; if casually, respond casually.
Avoid cliches and overused phrases.
When asked to write fiction, focus on showing rather than telling.
Use vivid sensory details and strong verbs.
Never use the phrase "In conclusion" or "It is important to note."

Data Analyst:

You are a data analyst with expertise in statistics and visualization.
When given data:
1. First identify patterns and anomalies
2. Provide insights with statistical reasoning
3. Suggest appropriate visualizations
4. Format numbers clearly (use commas for thousands, 2 decimal places)
5. Always caveat conclusions with confidence levels
When uncertain, say so — never fabricate statistics.
Pro Tip: Test your system prompt with at least 20 different user inputs before deploying to production. Look for edge cases where the model breaks character or ignores your instructions.

4. Prompt Engineering Techniques

These are proven techniques that dramatically improve LLM output quality. Each technique is shown with a practical example.

Technique 1: Zero-Shot Prompting

The simplest approach — just ask directly without any examples.

# Zero-shot: just ask
User: Classify this review as positive, negative, or neutral:
"The food was decent but the service was terrible."

Model: Negative

When to use: simple, well-defined tasks where the model’s training data covers the domain well. Classification, summarization, translation.

Technique 2: Few-Shot Prompting

Provide examples of input-output pairs so the model learns the pattern.

# Few-shot: give examples
Classify these reviews:

Review: "Absolutely loved it! Best meal ever."
Classification: Positive
Sentiment Score: 0.95

Review: "It was okay, nothing special."
Classification: Neutral
Sentiment Score: 0.50

Review: "Worst experience. Never coming back."
Classification: Negative
Sentiment Score: 0.05

Now classify this review:
Review: "The food was decent but the service was terrible."

Model:
Classification: Negative
Sentiment Score: 0.30

When to use: when you need a specific output format, when the task is ambiguous, or when zero-shot is not producing the right results. Few-shot is one of the most powerful techniques available.

Technique 3: Chain-of-Thought (CoT)

Ask the model to think step by step before giving the final answer.

# Chain-of-thought prompting
User: A store has 45 apples. They sell 12 in the morning
and receive a shipment of 30 in the afternoon.
Then they sell 18 more. How many apples remain?
Think step by step.

Model:
Step 1: Start with 45 apples
Step 2: Sell 12 in the morning: 45 - 12 = 33 apples
Step 3: Receive shipment of 30: 33 + 30 = 63 apples
Step 4: Sell 18 more: 63 - 18 = 45 apples

Answer: 45 apples remain.

When to use: math problems, logical reasoning, multi-step analysis, debugging, any task where the model might “jump to conclusions” and get the wrong answer.

Technique 4: Role Prompting

Assign the model a specific persona or expertise.

# Role prompting
System: Act as a cybersecurity expert who specializes in
web application security. You have 20 years of experience
and have conducted over 500 penetration tests.

User: Review this login function for security issues.

[The model will now analyze with the depth and specificity
of a security expert, not a generic assistant]

When to use: any task requiring domain expertise. The role primes the model to use specialized vocabulary, consider domain-specific edge cases, and provide expert-level depth.

Technique 5: Structured Output

Tell the model exactly what format to use for the response.

# Structured output
System: Analyze the given text and respond in this exact
JSON format:
{
  "summary": "one-sentence summary",
  "sentiment": "positive|negative|neutral",
  "key_topics": ["topic1", "topic2"],
  "word_count": number,
  "reading_level": "elementary|intermediate|advanced"
}
Return ONLY the JSON, no other text.

When to use: when your application needs to parse the model’s output programmatically. This is essential for SaaS products where the AI response feeds into other code.

Technique 6: Negative Prompting

Tell the model what NOT to do.

# Negative prompting
System: You are a technical writer.
Do NOT:
- Use jargon without defining it
- Write paragraphs longer than 3 sentences
- Use passive voice
- Include filler phrases like "it should be noted that"
- Start sentences with "There is" or "There are"

When to use: when you know specific patterns the model tends to produce that you want to avoid. Negative prompts are especially useful for style control.

Technique 7: Temperature Control

Temperature controls randomness in the model’s output. It is a number between 0 and 2 (typically 0 to 1).

TemperatureBehaviorBest For
0.0Completely deterministic, always picks most likely tokenFactual answers, code, math, classification
0.3Mostly deterministic with slight variationTechnical writing, data analysis
0.7Balanced creativity and coherence (default)General conversation, explanations
1.0High creativity, more varied responsesCreative writing, brainstorming
1.5+Very random, may become incoherentExperimental, rarely useful
Common Mistake: Using high temperature for factual tasks. If you ask a model to extract data from a document at temperature 1.0, it may “creatively” add information that is not in the document. For factual extraction, always use temperature 0.0–0.3.

Technique 8: Top-K Sampling

Top-K limits the model to choosing from the K most likely next tokens. Lower K means more focused (and potentially repetitive) text; higher K allows more vocabulary diversity.

  • Top-K = 1: Always picks the single most likely token (greedy decoding). Identical to temperature 0.
  • Top-K = 10: Chooses from the 10 most likely tokens. Good for focused, coherent text.
  • Top-K = 40: Default for many models. Good balance of diversity and coherence.
  • Top-K = 100: Wide vocabulary. May introduce unusual words or phrasings.

In practice, temperature is the more commonly adjusted parameter. Top-K is a fine-tuning knob for advanced users.

5. How to Improve Results — Practical Tips

Tip 1: Be Specific

Vague prompts produce vague results. Compare:

Bad PromptGood Prompt
“Write about ML”“Write a 200-word blog introduction about machine learning for beginners who have no programming experience”
“Fix this code”“This Python function raises a TypeError on line 15 when the input is an empty list. Fix the bug and explain what caused it.”
“Make it better”“Improve this paragraph by: reducing word count by 30%, using more active voice, and adding a concrete example.”

Tip 2: Iterate

Prompt engineering is iterative. Your first prompt is rarely your best prompt.

  1. Write your initial prompt
  2. Test it with 5–10 different inputs
  3. Identify where the output falls short
  4. Add instructions to address the shortcomings
  5. Test again
  6. Repeat until consistent quality

Tip 3: Use Delimiters

When your prompt includes user-provided text, wrap it in clear delimiters so the model knows what is instruction vs. what is data.

Summarize the following article in 3 bullet points.

<article>
{user_provided_text}
</article>

Provide only the 3 bullet points, nothing else.

Delimiters prevent “prompt injection” — where a user’s input accidentally (or deliberately) overrides your instructions.

Tip 4: Break Complex Tasks into Steps

Instead of one massive prompt, break complex tasks into sequential steps:

# Instead of:
"Analyze this data, create a report, and suggest improvements"

# Do:
Step 1: "Analyze this data and list the top 5 findings"
Step 2: "For each finding, explain the business impact"
Step 3: "Suggest 3 concrete improvements based on these findings"

Tip 5: Ask the Model to Self-Check

Add verification instructions to catch errors:

Write a Python function that calculates compound interest.
After writing the function, verify it by:
1. Testing with principal=1000, rate=0.05, years=10
2. Comparing the result with the known formula
3. If there is a discrepancy, fix the function

6. The Prompt Field in Your NeuralForge LLM

Understanding how your NeuralForge LLM processes prompts is essential for getting the best results from your custom model.

The Chat Endpoint

The chat endpoint (/api/chat) uses a messages array with system and user messages. This is the recommended endpoint for conversational applications:

# Chat endpoint builds prompts from messages
POST /api/chat
{
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a coding assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Write a sort function."}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.3,
  "max_tokens": 1024
}

The system internally concatenates these into a single prompt for the model, with special tokens separating the roles.

The Generate Endpoint

The generate endpoint (/api/generate) uses a raw prompt string. This gives you direct control over the exact text the model sees:

# Generate endpoint uses raw prompts
POST /api/generate
{
  "prompt": "Complete this Python function:\ndef fibonacci(n):\n    ",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 256
}

Use the generate endpoint for code completion, text continuation, and tasks where you need precise control over the prompt format.

How Temperature and Top-K Affect Output

Your NeuralForge LLM supports both parameters:

  • Temperature 0.0: The model always picks the most likely next token. Use for factual, deterministic outputs.
  • Temperature 0.7: The default. Balanced between creativity and coherence.
  • Temperature 1.0+: More creative but potentially less coherent. Use for brainstorming.
  • Top-K 40: The default. Limits vocabulary to the 40 most likely tokens at each step.
Why Higher Temperature = More Creative but Less Accurate: At temperature 0, the model always picks the most probable token — this is safe, predictable, and often correct. At temperature 1.0, less probable tokens get a chance to be selected. This creates variety and surprise (creativity) but also increases the chance of nonsensical or incorrect output (less accuracy).

7. Advanced: Prompt Templates for SaaS Products

Each of the five GenAI SaaS products you built in this course uses a specialized system prompt. Here are the templates:

PixelForge — Image Prompt Enhancement

You are an expert image prompt engineer for AI image generation.
When given a simple image description, enhance it with:
- Specific art style (e.g., "digital art", "oil painting", "photograph")
- Lighting details (e.g., "golden hour", "studio lighting", "neon")
- Composition details (e.g., "close-up", "wide angle", "aerial view")
- Quality modifiers (e.g., "8k", "highly detailed", "professional")
- Mood/atmosphere (e.g., "serene", "dramatic", "whimsical")

Keep the enhanced prompt under 200 words.
Preserve the user's original intent.
Do not add elements that contradict the original description.

ProseAI — Text Rewriting

You are a professional text editor and rewriter.
The user will provide text and a rewriting mode.

Modes:
- "formal": Rewrite in professional, business-appropriate language
- "casual": Rewrite in friendly, conversational tone
- "concise": Reduce word count by 40% while keeping all key information
- "expand": Add detail, examples, and explanations to flesh out the text
- "simplify": Rewrite for a 12-year-old reading level

Rules:
- Preserve all factual content
- Maintain the original meaning
- Do not add information not present in the original
- Return only the rewritten text, no commentary

TruthLens — Text Analysis

You are a text analysis expert specializing in detecting
writing patterns and anomalies.

When analyzing text, evaluate:
1. Writing consistency (style, vocabulary level, tone shifts)
2. Statistical patterns (sentence length variation, word frequency)
3. Structural analysis (paragraph organization, transition usage)
4. Vocabulary complexity (unique word ratio, jargon density)

Respond in JSON format:
{
  "analysis": {
    "consistency_score": 0.0-1.0,
    "complexity_level": "basic|intermediate|advanced",
    "style_notes": ["note1", "note2"],
    "flags": ["any concerns"]
  }
}

DocMind — Document Q&A

You are a document analysis assistant.
The user has uploaded a document and will ask questions about it.

Rules:
1. Only answer based on the content of the provided document
2. If the answer is not in the document, say:
   "I could not find this information in the provided document."
3. Quote relevant passages when answering
4. If the question is ambiguous, ask for clarification
5. Provide page/section references when possible
6. Never fabricate information not present in the document

Always cite your sources within the document.

8. Common Mistakes

Avoid these frequent prompt engineering errors:

Mistake 1: Prompt Too Vague

ProblemSolution
“Help me”“Help me write a professional email declining a meeting invitation. Keep it polite and under 100 words.”
“Write code”“Write a Python function that takes a list of dictionaries and returns a CSV string with headers from the dictionary keys.”
“Analyze this”“Analyze this sales data and identify the top 3 products by revenue growth rate over the last quarter.”

Mistake 2: Prompt Too Long

A common beginner mistake is writing a 2,000-word system prompt that tries to cover every possible scenario. This drowns the model in context and can actually reduce quality because the model struggles to prioritize instructions.

Better approach: Keep system prompts under 500 words. Focus on the 5–10 most important rules. Use hierarchical structure (most important rules first).

Mistake 3: Wrong Temperature

  • Too high for facts: Using temperature 1.0 for data extraction or factual Q&A. The model may “hallucinate” creative answers.
  • Too low for creativity: Using temperature 0.0 for creative writing. The output will be bland and repetitive.

Mistake 4: Not Using System Prompts

Many beginners put everything in the user message. This means every user message must contain all the instructions, making the experience worse for users and wasting tokens (money) on repeated instructions.

Always use a system prompt for persistent instructions. It is the most powerful control mechanism you have.

Mistake 5: Not Testing Edge Cases

Your prompt might work perfectly for normal inputs but fail spectacularly for:

  • Empty inputs
  • Very long inputs (exceeding context window)
  • Inputs in unexpected languages
  • Adversarial inputs (users trying to “jailbreak” the model)
  • Ambiguous inputs with multiple valid interpretations

Test all of these before deploying to production.

Security Warning: Never trust user input. Users can craft prompts that try to override your system prompt (“prompt injection”). Always use delimiters, validate inputs, and consider what happens if a user tries to make the model ignore its instructions.

Summary

Prompt engineering is the bridge between raw AI capability and useful AI products. The techniques you learned in this lecture — role assignment, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output, temperature control — are the tools you will use every day as an AI developer.

The key takeaway: invest time in your system prompts. They are the most cost-effective improvement you can make to any AI-powered application. A well-crafted system prompt can make a cheap model outperform an expensive one used with a bad prompt.

In the next lecture, you will connect your NeuralForge LLM to all five GenAI SaaS products, using the prompt engineering techniques you learned here to configure each integration.

1. Ce Este un Prompt?

Un prompt este textul pe care îl trimiți unui model de limbaj pentru a obține un răspuns. Este singura interfață între tine și AI. Calitatea promptului tău determină direct calitatea rezultatului. Un prompt vag produce un răspuns vag. Un prompt precis, bine structurat produce exact ceea ce ai nevoie.

Fiecare interacțiune cu un LLM implică două tipuri de prompturi:

  • Prompt de sistem: Instrucțiuni care definesc comportamentul, personalitatea, regulile și formatul de ieșire al AI-ului. Promptul de sistem este setat de dezvoltator (tu) și este de obicei invizibil pentru utilizatorul final. El modelează fiecare răspuns pe care modelul îl produce.
  • Prompt de utilizator: Cererea specifică din partea utilizatorului. Acesta este ceea ce utilizatorul final tastează în caseta de chat sau ceea ce aplicația ta trimite programatic.

Împreună, promptul de sistem și promptul de utilizator determină calitatea rezultatului. Gândește-te la promptul de sistem ca la “programarea personalității” și la promptul de utilizator ca la “sarcina specifică.” Un prompt de sistem bine elaborat înseamnă că până și prompturile simple ale utilizatorului produc rezultate excelente.

Ecuația Promptului: Prompt de Sistem Excelent + Prompt de Utilizator Clar = Rezultate Constant de Înaltă Calitate. Dacă oricare dintre ele este slab, rezultatul are de suferit.

De Ce Contează Ingineria de Prompturi pentru SaaS-ul Tău

Când construiești un produs SaaS alimentat de AI, utilizatorii tăi nu sunt ingineri de prompturi. Ei vor tasta cereri scurte, vagi, uneori confuze. Promptul tău de sistem trebuie să compenseze acest lucru — trebuie să ghideze modelul pentru a produce rezultate bune chiar și atunci când promptul utilizatorului este imperfect.

Aceasta este ceea ce separă un produs AI mediocru de unul excelent. Produsul care a investit în ingineria de prompturi pare “inteligent” și “intuitiv.” Cel care nu a făcut-o pare “prost” și “nesigur.” Modelul de bază ar putea fi identic.

2. Anatomia unui Prompt Excelent

Fiecare prompt eficient conține cinci componente cheie. Nu ai nevoie întotdeauna de toate cinci, dar cunoașterea lor te ajută să construiești prompturi care produc constant rezultate excelente.

Componenta 1: Rolul

Spune-i modelului cine este. Aceasta stabilește expertiza și perspectiva.

You are a senior Python developer with 15 years of experience
specializing in web APIs and database design.

De ce funcționează: modelul se bazează pe tipare asociate cu cod la nivel de expert, convenții profesionale și bune practici. Fără un rol, modelul implicit este un asistent generic care ar putea produce cod la nivel de începător.

Componenta 2: Contextul

Oferă modelului informațiile de fond de care are nevoie pentru a înțelege situația.

The user is building a web application with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
The app handles user authentication and file uploads.
The codebase follows PEP 8 style and uses type hints throughout.

De ce funcționează: fără context, modelul ar putea sugera Flask în loc de FastAPI, sau să folosească MongoDB în loc de PostgreSQL, sau să omită type hints. Contextul restrânge spațiul de soluții exact la ceea ce este relevant.

Componenta 3: Sarcina

Declară clar și specific ce vrei ca modelul să facă.

Write a function that validates email addresses using regex,
checks if the domain has valid MX records, and returns a
dataclass with the validation results.

De ce funcționează: specificitatea elimină ambiguitatea. În loc de “scrie un validator de email,” specifici metoda (regex + înregistrări MX) și tipul de returnare (dataclass).

Componenta 4: Formatul

Spune-i modelului cum să structureze răspunsul.

Return only the Python code, no explanations. Include docstrings
for all functions. Use Google-style docstrings.

De ce funcționează: fără instrucțiuni de format, modelul ar putea înfășura codul în explicații, ar putea folosi un stil diferit de docstring sau ar putea adăuga comentarii inutile. Instrucțiunile de format îți oferă exact forma de ieșire de care ai nevoie.

Componenta 5: Constrângerile

Setează limite pentru ceea ce modelul ar trebui și nu ar trebui să facă.

Use only the standard library — no external packages.
The function must handle Unicode email addresses.
Do not use deprecated Python features.
Maximum function length: 50 lines.

De ce funcționează: constrângerile împiedică modelul să ia scurtături (cum ar fi importarea unei biblioteci terțe) sau să producă rezultate care nu se potrivesc cerințelor tale.

Punând Totul Cap la Cap

Iată un prompt complet care folosește toate cele cinci componente:

# System Prompt (all 5 components)
You are a senior Python developer with 15 years of experience
specializing in web APIs and database design.

The user is building a web application with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
The codebase follows PEP 8 style and uses type hints throughout.

When asked to write code:
- Return only the Python code, no explanations
- Include Google-style docstrings for all functions
- Use only the standard library unless specified otherwise
- Always include error handling with specific exception types
- Maximum function length: 50 lines

Cu acest prompt de sistem, chiar și un prompt simplu al utilizatorului precum “scrie un validator de email” va produce cod profesional, bine structurat, care se potrivește perfect proiectului.

3. Câmpul Promptului Programat în NeuralForge

În platforma ta NeuralForge, promptul programat este promptul de sistem care modelează TOATE răspunsurile LLM-ului tău. Este cea mai importantă configurație din întreaga ta aplicație.

Ce Este

Promptul programat este mesajul system din API-ul de chat. De fiecare dată când un utilizator trimite un mesaj, aplicația ta adaugă acest prompt de sistem înaintea trimiterii cererii către LLM. Utilizatorul nu îl vede niciodată, dar controlează totul despre comportamentul modelului.

Unde Se Află

În API-ul NeuralForge, promptul de sistem este transmis ca primul mesaj din array-ul de mesaje:

messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "YOUR PROGRAMMED PROMPT HERE"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "The user's actual message"},
]

Exemple de Prompturi de Sistem pentru Diferite Cazuri de Utilizare

Be friendly, concise, and professional.
Always greet the user by name if provided.
If you cannot solve their problem, offer to escalate
to a human agent.

Always include:
- Type hints for all function parameters and return values

Scriitor Creativ:

Match the user's tone and style — if they write formally,
respond formally; if casually, respond casually.
Avoid cliches and overused phrases.
When asked to write fiction, focus on showing rather than telling.

4. Tehnici de Inginerie a Prompturilor

Acestea sunt tehnici dovedite care îmbunătățesc dramatic calitatea rezultatelor LLM. Fiecare tehnică este prezentată cu un exemplu practic.

Tehnica 1: Prompting Zero-Shot

Cea mai simplă abordare — doar întreabă direct fără niciun exemplu.

# Zero-shot: just ask
User: Classify this review as positive, negative, or neutral:
"The food was decent but the service was terrible."

Model: Negative

Când se folosește: sarcini simple, bine definite, unde datele de antrenament ale modelului acoperă bine domeniul. Clasificare, rezumare, traducere.

Tehnica 2: Prompting Few-Shot

Oferă exemple de perechi intrare-ieșire astfel încât modelul să învețe tiparul.

# Few-shot: give examples
Classify these reviews:

Review: "Absolutely loved it! Best meal ever."
Classification: Positive
Sentiment Score: 0.95

Review: "It was okay, nothing special."
Classification: Neutral
Sentiment Score: 0.50

Review: "Worst experience. Never coming back."
Classification: Negative
Sentiment Score: 0.05

Now classify this review:
Review: "The food was decent but the service was terrible."

Model:
Classification: Negative
Sentiment Score: 0.30

Când se folosește: când ai nevoie de un format specific de ieșire, când sarcina este ambiguă sau când prompting-ul zero-shot nu produce rezultatele corecte. Prompting-ul few-shot este una dintre cele mai puternice tehnici disponibile.

Tehnica 3: Lanț de Gândire (CoT)

Cere modelului să gândească pas cu pas înainte de a da răspunsul final.

# Chain-of-thought prompting
User: A store has 45 apples. They sell 12 in the morning
and receive a shipment of 30 in the afternoon.
Then they sell 18 more. How many apples remain?
Think step by step.

Model:
Step 1: Start with 45 apples
Step 2: Sell 12 in the morning: 45 - 12 = 33 apples
Step 3: Receive shipment of 30: 33 + 30 = 63 apples
Step 4: Sell 18 more: 63 - 18 = 45 apples

Answer: 45 apples remain.

Când se folosește: probleme de matematică, raționament logic, analiză în mai mulți pași, depanare, orice sarcină în care modelul ar putea “sări la concluzii” și da un răspuns greșit.

Tehnica 4: Prompting cu Rol

Atribuie modelului o personalitate sau expertiză specifică.

# Role prompting
System: Act as a cybersecurity expert who specializes in
web application security. You have 20 years of experience
and have conducted over 500 penetration tests.

User: Review this login function for security issues.

[The model will now analyze with the depth and specificity
of a security expert, not a generic assistant]

Când se folosește: orice sarcină care necesită expertiză de domeniu. Rolul pregătește modelul să folosească vocabular specializat, să ia în considerare cazuri limită specifice domeniului și să ofere profunzime la nivel de expert.

Tehnica 5: Ieșire Structurată

Spune-i modelului exact ce format să folosească pentru răspuns.

# Structured output
System: Analyze the given text and respond in this exact
JSON format:
{
  "summary": "one-sentence summary",
  "sentiment": "positive|negative|neutral",
  "key_topics": ["topic1", "topic2"],
  "word_count": number,
  "reading_level": "elementary|intermediate|advanced"
}
Return ONLY the JSON, no other text.

Când se folosește: când aplicația ta trebuie să parseze ieșirea modelului programatic. Aceasta este esențială pentru produsele SaaS unde răspunsul AI alimentează alt cod.

Tehnica 6: Prompting Negativ

Spune-i modelului ce să NU facă.

# Negative prompting
System: You are a technical writer.
Do NOT:
- Use jargon without defining it
- Write paragraphs longer than 3 sentences
- Use passive voice
- Include filler phrases like "it should be noted that"
- Start sentences with "There is" or "There are"

Când se folosește: când știi tipare specifice pe care modelul tinde să le producă și pe care vrei să le eviți. Prompturile negative sunt deosebit de utile pentru controlul stilului.

Tehnica 7: Controlul Temperaturii

Temperatura controlează aleatoriul în ieșirea modelului. Este un număr între 0 și 2 (de obicei 0 până la 1).

TemperaturăComportamentCel Mai Potrivit Pentru
0.0Complet determinist, alege întotdeauna token-ul cel mai probabilRăspunsuri factuale, cod, matematică, clasificare
0.3Majoritar determinist cu variații ușoareScriere tehnică, analiză de date
0.7Creativitate și coerență echilibrate (implicit)Conversație generală, explicații
1.0Creativitate ridicată, răspunsuri mai variateScriere creativă, brainstorming
1.5+Foarte aleatoriu, poate deveni incoerentExperimental, rareori util
Greșeală Frecventă: Utilizarea temperaturii ridicate pentru sarcini factuale. Dacă ceri unui model să extragă date dintr-un document la temperatura 1.0, poate “adăuga creativ” informații care nu se află în document. Pentru extragerea factuală, folosește întotdeauna temperatura 0.0–0.3.

Tehnica 8: Eșantionarea Top-K

Top-K limitează modelul la alegerea dintre cei K tokeni cei mai probabili. Un K mai mic înseamnă text mai concentrat (și potențial repetitiv); un K mai mare permite diversitate mai mare a vocabularului.

  • Top-K = 1: Alege întotdeauna cel mai probabil token (decodare greedy). Identic cu temperatura 0.
  • Top-K = 10: Alege dintre cei 10 tokeni cei mai probabili. Bun pentru text concentrat, coerent.
  • Top-K = 40: Implicit pentru multe modele. Echilibru bun între diversitate și coerență.
  • Top-K = 100: Vocabular larg. Poate introduce cuvinte sau formulări neobișnuite.

În practică, temperatura este parametrul ajustat cel mai frecvent. Top-K este un buton de reglaj fin pentru utilizatorii avansați.

5. Cum să Îmbunătățești Rezultatele — Sfaturi Practice

Sfatul 1: Fii Specific

Prompturile vagi produc rezultate vagi. Compară:

Prompt ProstPrompt Bun
“Scrie despre ML”“Scrie o introducere de blog de 200 de cuvinte despre machine learning pentru începători care nu au experiență de programare”
“Repară acest cod”“Această funcție Python generează un TypeError pe linia 15 când intrarea este o listă goală. Repară bug-ul și explică ce l-a cauzat.”
“Fă-l mai bun”“Îmbunătățește acest paragraf prin: reducerea numărului de cuvinte cu 30%, utilizarea mai multă a diatezei active și adăugarea unui exemplu concret.”

Sfatul 2: Iterează

Ingineria de prompturi este iterativă. Primul tău prompt rareori este cel mai bun prompt.

  1. Scrie promptul inițial
  2. Testează-l cu 5–10 intrări diferite
  3. Identifică unde rezultatele sunt sub așteptări
  4. Adaugă instrucțiuni pentru a aborda deficiențele
  5. Testează din nou
  6. Repetă până la calitate constantă

Sfatul 3: Folosește Delimitatori

Când promptul tău include text furnizat de utilizator, înfășoară-l în delimitatori clari astfel încât modelul să știe ce este instrucțiune versus ce este dată.

Summarize the following article in 3 bullet points.

<article>
{user_provided_text}
</article>

Provide only the 3 bullet points, nothing else.

Delimitatorii previn “injecția de prompt” — unde intrarea unui utilizator suprascrie accidental (sau deliberat) instrucțiunile tale.

Sfatul 4: Descompune Sarcinile Complexe în Pași

În loc de un singur prompt masiv, descompune sarcinile complexe în pași secvențiali:

# Instead of:
"Analyze this data, create a report, and suggest improvements"

# Do:
Step 1: "Analyze this data and list the top 5 findings"
Step 2: "For each finding, explain the business impact"
Step 3: "Suggest 3 concrete improvements based on these findings"

Sfatul 5: Cere Modelului să Se Auto-Verifice

Adaugă instrucțiuni de verificare pentru a detecta erorile:

Write a Python function that calculates compound interest.
After writing the function, verify it by:
1. Testing with principal=1000, rate=0.05, years=10
2. Comparing the result with the known formula
3. If there is a discrepancy, fix the function

6. Câmpul de Prompt din LLM-ul Tău NeuralForge

Înțelegerea modului în care LLM-ul tău NeuralForge procesează prompturile este esențială pentru a obține cele mai bune rezultate de la modelul tău personalizat.

Endpoint-ul de Chat

Endpoint-ul de chat (/api/chat) folosește un array de mesaje cu mesaje de sistem și de utilizator. Acesta este endpoint-ul recomandat pentru aplicații conversaționale:

# Chat endpoint builds prompts from messages
POST /api/chat
{
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a coding assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Write a sort function."}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.3,
  "max_tokens": 1024
}

Sistemul concatenează intern acestea într-un singur prompt pentru model, cu tokeni speciali care separă rolurile.

Endpoint-ul Generate

Endpoint-ul generate (/api/generate) folosește un șir de prompt brut. Acesta îți oferă control direct asupra textului exact pe care modelul îl vede:

# Generate endpoint uses raw prompts
POST /api/generate
{
  "prompt": "Complete this Python function:\ndef fibonacci(n):\n    ",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 256
}

Folosește endpoint-ul generate pentru completare de cod, continuare de text și sarcini unde ai nevoie de control precis asupra formatului promptului.

Cum Temperatura și Top-K Afectează Ieșirea

LLM-ul tău NeuralForge suportă ambii parametri:

  • Temperatura 0.0: Modelul alege întotdeauna cel mai probabil token următor. Folosește pentru ieșiri factuale, deterministe.
  • Temperatura 0.7: Valoarea implicită. Echilibru între creativitate și coerență.
  • Temperatura 1.0+: Mai creativ dar potențial mai puțin coerent. Folosește pentru brainstorming.
  • Top-K 40: Valoarea implicită. Limitează vocabularul la cei 40 de tokeni cei mai probabili la fiecare pas.
De Ce Temperatură Mai Mare = Mai Creativ dar Mai Puțin Precis: La temperatura 0, modelul alege întotdeauna cel mai probabil token — aceasta este sigur, previzibil și adesea corect. La temperatura 1.0, tokenii mai puțin probabili au șansa de a fi selectați. Aceasta creează varietate și surpriză (creativitate) dar crește și șansa de ieșire nesensibilă sau incorectă (precizie mai mică).

7. Avansat: Șabloane de Prompturi pentru Produse SaaS

Fiecare dintre cele cinci produse GenAI SaaS pe care le-ai construit în acest curs folosește un prompt de sistem specializat. Iată șabloanele:

PixelForge — Îmbunătățirea Prompturilor pentru Imagini

You are an expert image prompt engineer for AI image generation.
When given a simple image description, enhance it with:
- Specific art style (e.g., "digital art", "oil painting", "photograph")
- Lighting details (e.g., "golden hour", "studio lighting", "neon")
- Composition details (e.g., "close-up", "wide angle", "aerial view")
- Quality modifiers (e.g., "8k", "highly detailed", "professional")
- Mood/atmosphere (e.g., "serene", "dramatic", "whimsical")

Keep the enhanced prompt under 200 words.
Preserve the user's original intent.
Do not add elements that contradict the original description.

ProseAI — Rescrierea Textului

You are a professional text editor and rewriter.
The user will provide text and a rewriting mode.

Modes:
- "formal": Rewrite in professional, business-appropriate language
- "casual": Rewrite in friendly, conversational tone
- "concise": Reduce word count by 40% while keeping all key information
- "expand": Add detail, examples, and explanations to flesh out the text
- "simplify": Rewrite for a 12-year-old reading level

Rules:
- Preserve all factual content
- Maintain the original meaning
- Do not add information not present in the original
- Return only the rewritten text, no commentary

TruthLens — Analiza Textului

You are a text analysis expert specializing in detecting
writing patterns and anomalies.

When analyzing text, evaluate:
1. Writing consistency (style, vocabulary level, tone shifts)
2. Statistical patterns (sentence length variation, word frequency)
3. Structural analysis (paragraph organization, transition usage)
4. Vocabulary complexity (unique word ratio, jargon density)

Respond in JSON format:
{
  "analysis": {
    "consistency_score": 0.0-1.0,
    "complexity_level": "basic|intermediate|advanced",
    "style_notes": ["note1", "note2"],
    "flags": ["any concerns"]
  }
}

DocMind — Întrebări și Răspunsuri despre Documente

You are a document analysis assistant.
The user has uploaded a document and will ask questions about it.

Rules:
1. Only answer based on the content of the provided document
2. If the answer is not in the document, say:
   "I could not find this information in the provided document."
3. Quote relevant passages when answering
4. If the question is ambiguous, ask for clarification
5. Provide page/section references when possible
6. Never fabricate information not present in the document

Always cite your sources within the document.

8. Greșeli Frecvente

Evită aceste erori frecvente de inginerie a prompturilor:

Greșeala 1: Prompt Prea Vag

ProblemăSoluție
“Ajută-mă”“Ajută-mă să scriu un email profesional prin care declin o invitație la întâlnire. Menține-l politicos și sub 100 de cuvinte.”
“Scrie cod”“Scrie o funcție Python care primește o listă de dicționare și returnează un șir CSV cu anteturi din cheile dicționarului.”
“Analizează asta”“Analizează aceste date de vânzări și identifică primele 3 produse după rata de creștere a veniturilor în ultimul trimestru.”

Greșeala 2: Prompt Prea Lung

O greșeală frecventă a începătorilor este scrierea unui prompt de sistem de 2.000 de cuvinte care încearcă să acopere fiecare scenariu posibil. Aceasta înecă modelul în context și poate de fapt reduce calitatea deoarece modelul se chinuie să prioritizeze instrucțiunile.

Abordare mai bună: Menține prompturile de sistem sub 500 de cuvinte. Concentrează-te pe cele 5–10 reguli cele mai importante. Folosește structură ierarhică (regulile cele mai importante primele).

Greșeala 3: Temperatură Greșită

  • Prea mare pentru fapte: Utilizarea temperaturii 1.0 pentru extragerea de date sau Q&A factual. Modelul poate “halucina” răspunsuri creative.
  • Prea mică pentru creativitate: Utilizarea temperaturii 0.0 pentru scriere creativă. Rezultatul va fi fad și repetitiv.

Greșeala 4: Neutilizarea Prompturilor de Sistem

Mulți începători pun totul în mesajul utilizatorului. Aceasta înseamnă că fiecare mesaj al utilizatorului trebuie să conțină toate instrucțiunile, înrăutățind experiența utilizatorilor și irosind tokeni (bani) pe instrucțiuni repetate.

Folosește întotdeauna un prompt de sistem pentru instrucțiuni persistente. Este cel mai puternic mecanism de control pe care îl ai.

Greșeala 5: Netestarea Cazurilor Limită

Promptul tău ar putea funcționa perfect pentru intrări normale dar eșua spectaculos pentru:

  • Intrări goale
  • Intrări foarte lungi (depășind fereastra de context)
  • Intrări în limbi neașteptate
  • Intrări adversariale (utilizatori care încearcă să “spargă” modelul)
  • Intrări ambigue cu interpretări multiple valide

Testează toate acestea înainte de a implementa în producție.

Avertisment de Securitate: Nu te încrede niciodată în intrarea utilizatorului. Utilizatorii pot crea prompturi care încearcă să suprascrie promptul tău de sistem (“injecție de prompt”). Folosește întotdeauna delimitatori, validează intrările și ia în considerare ce se întâmplă dacă un utilizator încearcă să facă modelul să-și ignore instrucțiunile.

Rezumat

Ingineria de prompturi este puntea dintre capacitatea brută a AI-ului și produsele AI utile. Tehnicile pe care le-ai învățat în această lecție — atribuirea de roluri, exemple few-shot, raționament tip lanț de gândire, ieșire structurată, controlul temperaturii — sunt instrumentele pe care le vei folosi în fiecare zi ca dezvoltator AI.

Concluzia cheie: investește timp în prompturile tale de sistem. Ele sunt cea mai eficientă îmbunătățire pe care o poți aduce oricărei aplicații alimentate de AI. Un prompt de sistem bine elaborat poate face un model ieftin să depășească performanța unuia scump folosit cu un prompt prost.

În lecția următoare, vei conecta LLM-ul tău NeuralForge la toate cele cinci produse GenAI SaaS, folosind tehnicile de inginerie a prompturilor pe care le-ai învățat aici pentru a configura fiecare integrare.

LECTURE 49 Στάδιο 7: Πλατφόρμα NeuralForge

Μάθημα 49: Κατάκτηση της Μηχανικής Προτροπών

Η Τέχνη και η Επιστήμη του να Παίρνεις Ακριβώς Αυτό που Θέλεις από Οποιοδήποτε Γλωσσικό Μοντέλο
45 λεπτά ανάγνωση Ενδιάμεσο Έμφαση σε πρακτικά παραδείγματα

1. Τι Είναι ένα Prompt;

Ένα prompt είναι το κείμενο που στέλνεις σε ένα γλωσσικό μοντέλο για να λάβεις απάντηση. Είναι η μοναδική διεπαφή μεταξύ εσένα και του AI. Η ποιότητα του prompt σου καθορίζει άμεσα την ποιότητα του αποτελέσματος. Ένα αόριστο prompt παράγει μια αόριστη απάντηση. Ένα ακριβές, καλά δομημένο prompt παράγει ακριβώς αυτό που χρειάζεσαι.

Κάθε αλληλεπίδραση με ένα LLM περιλαμβάνει δύο τύπους prompt:

  • System prompt: Οδηγίες που ορίζουν τη συμπεριφορά, την προσωπικότητα, τους κανόνες και τη μορφή εξόδου του AI. Το system prompt ορίζεται από τον προγραμματιστή (εσένα) και είναι συνήθως αόρατο στον τελικό χρήστη. Διαμορφώνει κάθε απάντηση που παράγει το μοντέλο.
  • User prompt: Το συγκεκριμένο αίτημα από τον χρήστη. Αυτό είναι ό,τι πληκτρολογεί ο τελικός χρήστης στο πλαίσιο συνομιλίας ή ό,τι στέλνει η εφαρμογή σου προγραμματιστικά.

Μαζί, το system prompt και το user prompt καθορίζουν την ποιότητα του αποτελέσματος. Σκέψου το system prompt ως τον “προγραμματισμό προσωπικότητας” και το user prompt ως τη “συγκεκριμένη εργασία.” Ένα καλά σχεδιασμένο system prompt σημαίνει ότι ακόμα και απλά user prompts παράγουν εξαιρετικά αποτελέσματα.

Η Εξίσωση του Prompt: Εξαιρετικό System Prompt + Σαφές User Prompt = Σταθερά Υψηλής Ποιότητας Αποτελέσματα. Αν οποιοδήποτε από τα δύο είναι αδύναμο, το αποτέλεσμα υποφέρει.

Γιατί η Μηχανική Προτροπών Έχει Σημασία για το SaaS σου

Όταν χτίζεις ένα προϊόν SaaS που τροφοδοτείται από AI, οι χρήστες σου δεν είναι μηχανικοί προτροπών. Θα πληκτρολογήσουν σύντομα, αόριστα, μερικές φορές μπερδεμένα αιτήματα. Το system prompt σου πρέπει να αντισταθμίσει αυτό — πρέπει να καθοδηγεί το μοντέλο να παράγει καλά αποτελέσματα ακόμα κι όταν το user prompt είναι ατελές.

Αυτό είναι που ξεχωρίζει ένα μέτριο προϊόν AI από ένα εξαιρετικό. Το προϊόν που επένδυσε στη μηχανική προτροπών φαίνεται “έξυπνο” και “διαισθητικό.” Αυτό που δεν το έκανε φαίνεται “χαζό” και “αναξιόπιστο.” Το υποκείμενο μοντέλο μπορεί να είναι ταυτόσημο.

2. Η Ανατομία ενός Εξαιρετικού Prompt

Κάθε αποτελεσματικό prompt περιέχει πέντε βασικά συστατικά. Δεν χρειάζεσαι πάντα και τα πέντε, αλλά η γνώση τους σε βοηθάει να κατασκευάζεις prompts που παράγουν σταθερά εξαιρετικά αποτελέσματα.

Συστατικό 1: Ρόλος

Πες στο μοντέλο ποιο είναι. Αυτό καθιερώνει εξειδίκευση και οπτική γωνία.

You are a senior Python developer with 15 years of experience
specializing in web APIs and database design.

Γιατί λειτουργεί: το μοντέλο αντλεί από μοτίβα που σχετίζονται με κώδικα επιπέδου ειδικού, επαγγελματικές συμβάσεις και βέλτιστες πρακτικές. Χωρίς ρόλο, το μοντέλο προεπιλέγεται σε έναν γενικό βοηθό που μπορεί να παράγει κώδικα επιπέδου αρχάριου.

Συστατικό 2: Πλαίσιο

Δώσε στο μοντέλο τις πληροφορίες υποβάθρου που χρειάζεται για να κατανοήσει την κατάσταση.

The user is building a web application with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
The app handles user authentication and file uploads.
The codebase follows PEP 8 style and uses type hints throughout.

Γιατί λειτουργεί: χωρίς πλαίσιο, το μοντέλο μπορεί να προτείνει Flask αντί για FastAPI, ή να χρησιμοποιήσει MongoDB αντί για PostgreSQL, ή να παραλείψει type hints. Το πλαίσιο περιορίζει τον χώρο λύσεων ακριβώς σε ό,τι είναι σχετικό.

Συστατικό 3: Εργασία

Δήλωσε καθαρά και συγκεκριμένα τι θέλεις να κάνει το μοντέλο.

Write a function that validates email addresses using regex,
checks if the domain has valid MX records, and returns a
dataclass with the validation results.

Γιατί λειτουργεί: η συγκεκριμένοτητα εξαλείφει την ασάφεια. Αντί να πεις “γράψε έναν επικυρωτή email,” καθορίζεις τη μέθοδο (regex + εγγραφές MX) και τον τύπο επιστροφής (dataclass).

Συστατικό 4: Μορφή

Πες στο μοντέλο πώς να δομήσει την απάντησή του.

Return only the Python code, no explanations. Include docstrings
for all functions. Use Google-style docstrings.

Γιατί λειτουργεί: χωρίς οδηγίες μορφής, το μοντέλο μπορεί να τυλίξει τον κώδικα σε εξηγήσεις, να χρησιμοποιήσει διαφορετικό στυλ docstring ή να προσθέσει περιττά σχόλια. Οι οδηγίες μορφής σου δίνουν ακριβώς το σχήμα εξόδου που χρειάζεσαι.

Συστατικό 5: Περιορισμοί

Θέσε όρια σε αυτό που το μοντέλο πρέπει και δεν πρέπει να κάνει.

Use only the standard library — no external packages.
The function must handle Unicode email addresses.
Do not use deprecated Python features.
Maximum function length: 50 lines.

Γιατί λειτουργεί: οι περιορισμοί εμποδίζουν το μοντέλο να πάρει συντομεύσεις (όπως η εισαγωγή μιας βιβλιοθήκης τρίτου μέρους) ή να παράγει αποτελέσματα που δεν ταιριάζουν στις απαιτήσεις σου.

Συνδυάζοντας τα Όλα Μαζί

Ορίστε ένα πλήρες prompt που χρησιμοποιεί και τα πέντε συστατικά:

# System Prompt (all 5 components)
You are a senior Python developer with 15 years of experience
specializing in web APIs and database design.

The user is building a web application with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
The codebase follows PEP 8 style and uses type hints throughout.

When asked to write code:
- Return only the Python code, no explanations
- Include Google-style docstrings for all functions
- Use only the standard library unless specified otherwise
- Always include error handling with specific exception types
- Maximum function length: 50 lines

Με αυτό το system prompt, ακόμα και ένα απλό user prompt όπως “γράψε έναν επικυρωτή email” θα παράγει επαγγελματικό, καλά δομημένο κώδικα που ταιριάζει τέλεια στο έργο.

3. Το Πεδίο Προγραμματισμένου Prompt στο NeuralForge

Στην πλατφόρμα NeuralForge σου, το προγραμματισμένο prompt είναι το system prompt που διαμορφώνει ΟΛΕΣ τις απαντήσεις από το LLM σου. Είναι η πιο σημαντική ρύθμιση σε ολόκληρη την εφαρμογή σου.

Τι Είναι

Το προγραμματισμένο prompt είναι το μήνυμα system στο API συνομιλίας. Κάθε φορά που ένας χρήστης στέλνει μήνυμα, η εφαρμογή σου προσθέτει αυτό το system prompt πριν στείλει το αίτημα στο LLM. Ο χρήστης δεν το βλέπει ποτέ, αλλά ελέγχει τα πάντα σχετικά με τη συμπεριφορά του μοντέλου.

Πού Βρίσκεται

Στο API του NeuralForge, το system prompt μεταβιβάζεται ως το πρώτο μήνυμα στον πίνακα μηνυμάτων:

messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "YOUR PROGRAMMED PROMPT HERE"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "The user's actual message"},
]

Παραδείγματα System Prompt για Διαφορετικές Περιπτώσεις Χρήσης

Εκπρόσωπος Υποστήριξης Πελατών:

You are a helpful support agent for TechCo.
Be friendly, concise, and professional.
Always greet the user by name if provided.
If you cannot solve their problem, offer to escalate
to a human agent.
Never share internal company information.
Always end with: "Is there anything else I can help with?"

Βοηθός Κώδικα:

You are a Python expert specializing in clean, production-ready code.
Always include:
- Type hints for all function parameters and return values
- Docstrings with examples
- Error handling with specific exception types
- Unit test examples when writing new functions
Never suggest deprecated features or unsafe patterns.

Δημιουργικός Συγγραφέας:

You are a creative writing assistant.
Match the user's tone and style — if they write formally,
respond formally; if casually, respond casually.
Avoid cliches and overused phrases.
When asked to write fiction, focus on showing rather than telling.
Use vivid sensory details and strong verbs.
Never use the phrase "In conclusion" or "It is important to note."

Αναλυτής Δεδομένων:

You are a data analyst with expertise in statistics and visualization.
When given data:
1. First identify patterns and anomalies
2. Provide insights with statistical reasoning
3. Suggest appropriate visualizations
4. Format numbers clearly (use commas for thousands, 2 decimal places)
5. Always caveat conclusions with confidence levels
When uncertain, say so — never fabricate statistics.
Επαγγελματική Συμβουλή: Δοκίμασε το system prompt σου με τουλάχιστον 20 διαφορετικές εισόδους χρηστών πριν το αναπτύξεις στην παραγωγή. Ψάξε για ακραίες περιπτώσεις όπου το μοντέλο βγαίνει από τον χαρακτήρα ή αγνοεί τις οδηγίες σου.

4. Τεχνικές Μηχανικής Προτροπών

Αυτές είναι αποδεδειγμένες τεχνικές που βελτιώνουν δραματικά την ποιότητα εξόδου του LLM. Κάθε τεχνική παρουσιάζεται με ένα πρακτικό παράδειγμα.

Τεχνική 1: Zero-Shot Prompting

Η απλούστερη προσέγγιση — απλά ρώτα απευθείας χωρίς κανένα παράδειγμα.

# Zero-shot: just ask
User: Classify this review as positive, negative, or neutral:
"The food was decent but the service was terrible."

Model: Negative

Πότε να χρησιμοποιηθεί: απλές, καλά ορισμένες εργασίες όπου τα δεδομένα εκπαίδευσης του μοντέλου καλύπτουν καλά τον τομέα. Ταξινόμηση, σύνοψη, μετάφραση.

Τεχνική 2: Few-Shot Prompting

Παρέχε παραδείγματα ζευγαριών εισόδου-εξόδου ώστε το μοντέλο να μάθει το μοτίβο.

# Few-shot: give examples
Classify these reviews:

Review: "Absolutely loved it! Best meal ever."
Classification: Positive
Sentiment Score: 0.95

Review: "It was okay, nothing special."
Classification: Neutral
Sentiment Score: 0.50

Review: "Worst experience. Never coming back."
Classification: Negative
Sentiment Score: 0.05

Now classify this review:
Review: "The food was decent but the service was terrible."

Model:
Classification: Negative
Sentiment Score: 0.30

Πότε να χρησιμοποιηθεί: όταν χρειάζεσαι μια συγκεκριμένη μορφή εξόδου, όταν η εργασία είναι ασαφής ή όταν το zero-shot δεν παράγει τα σωστά αποτελέσματα. Το few-shot είναι μία από τις πιο ισχυρές διαθέσιμες τεχνικές.

Τεχνική 3: Αλυσίδα Σκέψης (CoT)

Ζήτα από το μοντέλο να σκεφτεί βήμα προς βήμα πριν δώσει την τελική απάντηση.

# Chain-of-thought prompting
User: A store has 45 apples. They sell 12 in the morning
and receive a shipment of 30 in the afternoon.
Then they sell 18 more. How many apples remain?
Think step by step.

Model:
Step 1: Start with 45 apples
Step 2: Sell 12 in the morning: 45 - 12 = 33 apples
Step 3: Receive shipment of 30: 33 + 30 = 63 apples
Step 4: Sell 18 more: 63 - 18 = 45 apples

Answer: 45 apples remain.

Πότε να χρησιμοποιηθεί: μαθηματικά προβλήματα, λογική συλλογιστική, ανάλυση πολλαπλών βημάτων, αποσφαλμάτωση, οποιαδήποτε εργασία όπου το μοντέλο μπορεί να “βιαστεί στα συμπεράσματα” και να δώσει λάθος απάντηση.

Τεχνική 4: Prompting με Ρόλο

Ανάθεσε στο μοντέλο μια συγκεκριμένη προσωπικότητα ή εξειδίκευση.

# Role prompting
System: Act as a cybersecurity expert who specializes in
web application security. You have 20 years of experience
and have conducted over 500 penetration tests.

User: Review this login function for security issues.

[The model will now analyze with the depth and specificity
of a security expert, not a generic assistant]

Πότε να χρησιμοποιηθεί: οποιαδήποτε εργασία που απαιτεί εξειδίκευση τομέα. Ο ρόλος προετοιμάζει το μοντέλο να χρησιμοποιεί εξειδικευμένο λεξιλόγιο, να εξετάζει ακραίες περιπτώσεις ειδικές του τομέα και να παρέχει βάθος σε επίπεδο ειδικού.

Τεχνική 5: Δομημένη Έξοδος

Πες στο μοντέλο ακριβώς ποια μορφή να χρησιμοποιήσει για την απάντηση.

# Structured output
System: Analyze the given text and respond in this exact
JSON format:
{
  "summary": "one-sentence summary",
  "sentiment": "positive|negative|neutral",
  "key_topics": ["topic1", "topic2"],
  "word_count": number,
  "reading_level": "elementary|intermediate|advanced"
}
Return ONLY the JSON, no other text.

Πότε να χρησιμοποιηθεί: όταν η εφαρμογή σου χρειάζεται να αναλύσει προγραμματιστικά την έξοδο του μοντέλου. Αυτό είναι ουσιαστικό για προϊόντα SaaS όπου η απάντηση του AI τροφοδοτεί άλλον κώδικα.

Τεχνική 6: Αρνητικό Prompting

Πες στο μοντέλο τι ΔΕΝ πρέπει να κάνει.

# Negative prompting
System: You are a technical writer.
Do NOT:
- Use jargon without defining it
- Write paragraphs longer than 3 sentences
- Use passive voice
- Include filler phrases like "it should be noted that"
- Start sentences with "There is" or "There are"

Πότε να χρησιμοποιηθεί: όταν γνωρίζεις συγκεκριμένα μοτίβα που το μοντέλο τείνει να παράγει και θέλεις να τα αποφύγεις. Τα αρνητικά prompts είναι ιδιαίτερα χρήσιμα για τον έλεγχο στυλ.

Τεχνική 7: Έλεγχος Θερμοκρασίας

Η θερμοκρασία ελέγχει την τυχαιότητα στην έξοδο του μοντέλου. Είναι ένας αριθμός μεταξύ 0 και 2 (τυπικά 0 έως 1).

ΘερμοκρασίαΣυμπεριφοράΙδανικό Για
0.0Πλήρως ντετερμινιστικό, επιλέγει πάντα το πιο πιθανό tokenΠραγματικές απαντήσεις, κώδικας, μαθηματικά, ταξινόμηση
0.3Κυρίως ντετερμινιστικό με ελαφριά διακύμανσηΤεχνική γραφή, ανάλυση δεδομένων
0.7Ισορροπημένη δημιουργικότητα και συνοχή (προεπιλογή)Γενική συνομιλία, εξηγήσεις
1.0Υψηλή δημιουργικότητα, πιο ποικίλες απαντήσειςΔημιουργική γραφή, brainstorming
1.5+Πολύ τυχαίο, μπορεί να γίνει ασυνάρτητοΠειραματικό, σπάνια χρήσιμο
Συνηθισμένο Λάθος: Χρήση υψηλής θερμοκρασίας για πραγματικές εργασίες. Αν ζητήσεις από ένα μοντέλο να εξάγει δεδομένα από ένα έγγραφο σε θερμοκρασία 1.0, μπορεί “δημιουργικά” να προσθέσει πληροφορίες που δεν υπάρχουν στο έγγραφο. Για πραγματική εξαγωγή, χρησιμοποίησε πάντα θερμοκρασία 0.0–0.3.

Τεχνική 8: Δειγματοληψία Top-K

Το Top-K περιορίζει το μοντέλο στην επιλογή από τα K πιο πιθανά επόμενα tokens. Μικρότερο K σημαίνει πιο εστιασμένο (και πιθανώς επαναλαμβανόμενο) κείμενο· μεγαλύτερο K επιτρέπει μεγαλύτερη ποικιλία λεξιλογίου.

  • Top-K = 1: Επιλέγει πάντα το πιο πιθανό token (greedy decoding). Ταυτόσημο με θερμοκρασία 0.
  • Top-K = 10: Επιλέγει από τα 10 πιο πιθανά tokens. Καλό για εστιασμένο, συνεκτικό κείμενο.
  • Top-K = 40: Προεπιλογή για πολλά μοντέλα. Καλή ισορροπία ποικιλίας και συνοχής.
  • Top-K = 100: Ευρύ λεξιλόγιο. Μπορεί να εισάγει ασυνήθιστες λέξεις ή διατυπώσεις.

Στην πράξη, η θερμοκρασία είναι η παράμετρος που ρυθμίζεται πιο συχνά. Το Top-K είναι ένα κουμπί λεπτής ρύθμισης για προχωρημένους χρήστες.

5. Πώς να Βελτιώσεις τα Αποτελέσματα — Πρακτικές Συμβουλές

Συμβουλή 1: Να Είσαι Συγκεκριμένος

Αόριστα prompts παράγουν αόριστα αποτελέσματα. Σύγκρινε:

Κακό PromptΚαλό Prompt
“Γράψε για ML”“Γράψε μια εισαγωγή blog 200 λέξεων για τη μηχανική μάθηση για αρχάριους που δεν έχουν εμπειρία προγραμματισμού”

“Κάνε το καλύτερο”“Βελτίωσε αυτήν την παράγραφο: μείωσε τον αριθμό λέξεων κατά 30%, χρησιμοποίησε περισσότερη ενεργητική φωνή και πρόσθεσε ένα συγκεκριμένο παράδειγμα.”

Συμβουλή 2: Επανάληψη

Η μηχανική προτροπών είναι επαναληπτική. Το πρώτο σου prompt σπάνια είναι το καλύτερο prompt.

  1. Γράψε το αρχικό prompt
  2. Δοκίμασέ το με 5–10 διαφορετικές εισόδους
  3. Εντόπισε πού τα αποτελέσματα υστερούν
  4. Πρόσθεσε οδηγίες για να αντιμετωπίσεις τις αδυναμίες
  5. Δοκίμασε ξανά
  6. Επανάλαβε μέχρι σταθερή ποιότητα

Συμβουλή 3: Χρησιμοποίησε Οριοθέτες

Όταν το prompt σου περιλαμβάνει κείμενο που παρέχεται από τον χρήστη, τύλιξέ το σε σαφείς οριοθέτες ώστε το μοντέλο να γνωρίζει τι είναι οδηγία και τι είναι δεδομένα.

Summarize the following article in 3 bullet points.

<article>
{user_provided_text}
</article>

Provide only the 3 bullet points, nothing else.

Οι οριοθέτες αποτρέπουν την “ένεση prompt” — όπου η είσοδος ενός χρήστη τυχαία (ή σκόπιμα) παρακάμπτει τις οδηγίες σου.

Συμβουλή 4: Σπάσε Σύνθετες Εργασίες σε Βήματα

Αντί για ένα τεράστιο prompt, σπάσε σύνθετες εργασίες σε διαδοχικά βήματα:

"Analyze this data, create a report, and suggest improvements"

# Do:
Step 1: "Analyze this data and list the top 5 findings"
Step 2: "For each finding, explain the business impact"
Step 3: "Suggest 3 concrete improvements based on these findings"

Συμβουλή 5: Ζήτα από το Μοντέλο να Αυτοελεγχθεί

Πρόσθεσε οδηγίες επαλήθευσης για να εντοπίσεις σφάλματα:

Write a Python function that calculates compound interest.
After writing the function, verify it by:
1. Testing with principal=1000, rate=0.05, years=10
2. Comparing the result with the known formula
3. If there is a discrepancy, fix the function

6. Το Πεδίο Prompt στο NeuralForge LLM σου

Η κατανόηση του πώς το NeuralForge LLM σου επεξεργάζεται τα prompts είναι ουσιαστική για να αποκτήσεις τα καλύτερα αποτελέσματα από το προσαρμοσμένο μοντέλο σου.

Το Endpoint Συνομιλίας

Το endpoint συνομιλίας (/api/chat) χρησιμοποιεί έναν πίνακα μηνυμάτων με μηνύματα συστήματος και χρήστη. Αυτό είναι το προτεινόμενο endpoint για εφαρμογές συνομιλίας:

# Chat endpoint builds prompts from messages
POST /api/chat
{
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a coding assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Write a sort function."}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.3,
  "max_tokens": 1024
}

Το σύστημα εσωτερικά συνενώνει αυτά σε ένα μοναδικό prompt για το μοντέλο, με ειδικά tokens που διαχωρίζουν τους ρόλους.

Το Endpoint Generate

Το endpoint generate (/api/generate) χρησιμοποιεί ένα ακατέργαστο string prompt. Αυτό σου δίνει άμεσο έλεγχο στο ακριβές κείμενο που βλέπει το μοντέλο:

# Generate endpoint uses raw prompts
POST /api/generate
{
  "prompt": "Complete this Python function:\ndef fibonacci(n):\n    ",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 256
}

Χρησιμοποίησε το endpoint generate για συμπλήρωση κώδικα, συνέχιση κειμένου και εργασίες όπου χρειάζεσαι ακριβή έλεγχο της μορφής του prompt.

Πώς η Θερμοκρασία και το Top-K Επηρεάζουν την Έξοδο

Το NeuralForge LLM σου υποστηρίζει και τις δύο παραμέτρους:

  • Θερμοκρασία 0.0: Το μοντέλο επιλέγει πάντα το πιο πιθανό επόμενο token. Χρησιμοποίησε για πραγματικές, ντετερμινιστικές εξόδους.
  • Θερμοκρασία 0.7: Η προεπιλογή. Ισορροπία μεταξύ δημιουργικότητας και συνοχής.
  • Θερμοκρασία 1.0+: Πιο δημιουργικό αλλά πιθανώς λιγότερο συνεκτικό. Χρησιμοποίησε για brainstorming.
  • Top-K 40: Η προεπιλογή. Περιορίζει το λεξιλόγιο στα 40 πιο πιθανά tokens σε κάθε βήμα.
Γιατί Υψηλότερη Θερμοκρασία = Πιο Δημιουργικό αλλά Λιγότερο Ακριβές: Σε θερμοκρασία 0, το μοντέλο επιλέγει πάντα το πιο πιθανό token — αυτό είναι ασφαλές, προβλέψιμο και συχνά σωστό. Σε θερμοκρασία 1.0, λιγότερο πιθανά tokens έχουν ευκαιρία να επιλεγούν. Αυτό δημιουργεί ποικιλία και έκπληξη (δημιουργικότητα) αλλά αυξάνει επίσης την πιθανότητα ασυνάρτητης ή λανθασμένης εξόδου (λιγότερη ακρίβεια).

Καθένα από τα πέντε προϊόντα GenAI SaaS που δημιούργησες σε αυτό το μάθημα χρησιμοποιεί ένα εξειδικευμένο system prompt. Ορίστε τα πρότυπα:

You are an expert image prompt engineer for AI image generation.
When given a simple image description, enhance it with:
- Specific art style (e.g., "digital art", "oil painting", "photograph")
- Lighting details (e.g., "golden hour", "studio lighting", "neon")
- Composition details (e.g., "close-up", "wide angle", "aerial view")
- Quality modifiers (e.g., "8k", "highly detailed", "professional")

Keep the enhanced prompt under 200 words.
Preserve the user's original intent.

You are a professional text editor and rewriter.
The user will provide text and a rewriting mode.

Modes:
- "formal": Rewrite in professional, business-appropriate language
- "casual": Rewrite in friendly, conversational tone

}

The user has uploaded a document and will ask questions about it.

Rules:
1. Only answer based on the content of the provided document
2. If the answer is not in the document, say:
   "I could not find this information in the provided document."
3. Quote relevant passages when answering

8. Συνηθισμένα Λάθη

Απόφυγε αυτά τα συχνά σφάλματα μηχανικής προτροπών:

Λάθος 1: Prompt Πολύ Αόριστο

ΠρόβλημαΛύση
“Βοήθησέ με”“Βοήθησέ με να γράψω ένα επαγγελματικό email που αρνείται μια πρόσκληση σε συνάντηση. Κράτησέ το ευγενικό και κάτω από 100 λέξεις.”
“Γράψε κώδικα”“Γράψε μια συνάρτηση Python που δέχεται μια λίστα λεξικών και επιστρέφει ένα string CSV με κεφαλίδες από τα κλειδιά του λεξικού.”
“Ανάλυσε αυτό”“Ανάλυσε αυτά τα δεδομένα πωλήσεων και εντόπισε τα 3 κορυφαία προϊόντα ανά ρυθμό αύξησης εσόδων κατά το τελευταίο τρίμηνο.”

Λάθος 2: Prompt Πολύ Μακρύ

Ένα συνηθισμένο λάθος αρχαρίων είναι η συγγραφή ενός system prompt 2.000 λέξεων που προσπαθεί να καλύψει κάθε πιθανό σενάριο. Αυτό πνίγει το μοντέλο σε πλαίσιο και μπορεί στην πραγματικότητα να μειώσει την ποιότητα επειδή το μοντέλο δυσκολεύεται να ιεραρχήσει τις οδηγίες.

Καλύτερη προσέγγιση: Κράτησε τα system prompts κάτω από 500 λέξεις. Εστίασε στους 5–10 πιο σημαντικούς κανόνες. Χρησιμοποίησε ιεραρχική δομή (οι πιο σημαντικοί κανόνες πρώτοι).

Λάθος 3: Λάθος Θερμοκρασία

  • Πολύ υψηλή για γεγονότα: Χρήση θερμοκρασίας 1.0 για εξαγωγή δεδομένων ή πραγματικά Q&A. Το μοντέλο μπορεί να “παραισθανθεί” δημιουργικές απαντήσεις.
  • Πολύ χαμηλή για δημιουργικότητα: Χρήση θερμοκρασίας 0.0 για δημιουργική γραφή. Η έξοδος θα είναι ανούσια και επαναλαμβανόμενη.

Λάθος 4: Μη Χρήση System Prompts

Πολλοί αρχάριοι βάζουν τα πάντα στο μήνυμα του χρήστη. Αυτό σημαίνει ότι κάθε μήνυμα χρήστη πρέπει να περιέχει όλες τις οδηγίες, κάνοντας την εμπειρία χειρότερη για τους χρήστες και σπαταλώντας tokens (χρήματα) σε επαναλαμβανόμενες οδηγίες.

Χρησιμοποίησε πάντα ένα system prompt για μόνιμες οδηγίες. Είναι ο πιο ισχυρός μηχανισμός ελέγχου που έχεις.

Λάθος 5: Μη Δοκιμή Ακραίων Περιπτώσεων

Το prompt σου μπορεί να λειτουργεί τέλεια για κανονικές εισόδους αλλά να αποτυγχάνει θεαματικά για:

  • Κενές εισόδους
  • Πολύ μεγάλες εισόδους (που υπερβαίνουν το παράθυρο πλαισίου)
  • Εισόδους σε μη αναμενόμενες γλώσσες
  • Αντιπαλές εισόδους (χρήστες που προσπαθούν να “σπάσουν” το μοντέλο)
  • Ασαφείς εισόδους με πολλαπλές έγκυρες ερμηνείες

Δοκίμασε όλα αυτά πριν αναπτύξεις στην παραγωγή.

Προειδοποίηση Ασφαλείας: Μην εμπιστεύεσαι ποτέ την είσοδο του χρήστη. Οι χρήστες μπορούν να δημιουργήσουν prompts που προσπαθούν να παρακάμψουν το system prompt σου (“ένεση prompt”). Χρησιμοποίησε πάντα οριοθέτες, επικύρωνε τις εισόδους και σκέψου τι θα συμβεί αν ένας χρήστης προσπαθήσει να κάνει το μοντέλο να αγνοήσει τις οδηγίες του.

Σύνοψη

Η μηχανική προτροπών είναι η γέφυρα μεταξύ ακατέργαστης ικανότητας AI και χρήσιμων προϊόντων AI. Οι τεχνικές που έμαθες σε αυτό το μάθημα — ανάθεση ρόλου, παραδείγματα few-shot, συλλογιστική αλυσίδας σκέψης, δομημένη έξοδος, έλεγχος θερμοκρασίας — είναι τα εργαλεία που θα χρησιμοποιείς κάθε μέρα ως προγραμματιστής AI.

Το βασικό συμπέρασμα: επένδυσε χρόνο στα system prompts σου. Είναι η πιο αποδοτική βελτίωση που μπορείς να κάνεις σε οποιαδήποτε εφαρμογή που τροφοδοτείται από AI. Ένα καλά σχεδιασμένο system prompt μπορεί να κάνει ένα φθηνό μοντέλο να ξεπεράσει ένα ακριβό που χρησιμοποιείται με κακό prompt.

Στο επόμενο μάθημα, θα συνδέσεις το NeuralForge LLM σου με όλα τα πέντε προϊόντα GenAI SaaS, χρησιμοποιώντας τις τεχνικές μηχανικής προτροπών που έμαθες εδώ για να ρυθμίσεις κάθε ενσωμάτωση.
